scan_scope_note: Scan scoped to domain/business understanding (entities, controllers, business rules) for feature-catalog derivation, not a full architecture documentation pass. Requested explicitly by caller.

project_parts.primary_tech: ASP.NET Core 2.1 (C#), Entity Framework Core, MS-SQL, SignalR, ASP.NET Identity/JWT
Shared C# domain models/repositories referenced by backend-api
Xamarin.Forms, calls same backend-api (secondary/alternate client, product browsing subset)
Telegram Bot API client, calls same backend-api (secondary/alternate client, product browsing subset)

domain_entities: Product (with Category tree, EAV int/decimal/string properties, images, supplier price links)
Supplier (offers products at a supplier-specific price)
Order (items reference product+supplier+quantity, status lifecycle: Processing/Ready/Shipped/Cancelled)
Comment (generic, attachable to product/supplier/article, threaded/nested, no depth limit)
Rating (generic, attachable to product/supplier/article, 1 rating per user per entity, average recalculated)
findings.generic_entity_behavior: ProductController, SupplierController, ArticleController all derive from a shared EntityController<T> exposing: paginated list, count, create/update (role-gated), delete (role-gated), rating (set/get/list), threaded comments (add/edit/delete with author-or-moderator ownership check), view-count tracking ('Watch').
business_rules_observed: Editing a comment is rejected unless the requester is the comment's original author or has moderator/administrator role (EditForeignCommentAsync throws, action returns error to caller).
Placing an order fails validation if a cart line item has no valid supplier selected for that product (ArgumentException -> order rejected, client notified of failure).

Order status transition to 'Shipped' stamps a completion timestamp; any authorized role can change status; both the acting user and the order owner are notified (possibly differently) via real-time notification.

No stock/inventory quantity is tracked or checked anywhere in the order flow (explicit code comment acknowledges this); price is taken from the chosen supplier link at order time, not re-validated server-side against current supplier price.

Product edit/delete/list filtering supports arbitrary combinations of category, numeric range properties, text properties, free-text search and multi-field sorting (name/rating/views/custom property).
user_facing_capabilities: Category tree navigation (unlimited depth) with per-category dynamic filter properties
Product comparison across selected products (side-by-side dynamic property diff)
Full-text search across products and suppliers combined or separately
Threaded comments with add/edit/delete on products, suppliers, articles
5-star style rating with per-user rating and recalculated average
Shopping cart (client-side) -> checkout -> order creation -> order list/detail -> status tracking
Administrator role management and broadcast messaging to a user (admin console)
Real-time (SignalR) success/error/info notifications for actions performed
Alternate access channels (mobile app, Telegram bot) exposing a reduced product-browsing subset of the same backend

MobileClient/TelegramBot full source - sampled only, confirmed as thin alternate clients over the same product/supplier API
Exhaustive file-by-file read of every Angular component - representative feature folders sampled instead (cart, products, comments, rating, admin, statistics)
